title: About Me
paragraphs: Howdy! I’m Jadie Marshall, a full-stack software engineer and Texas A&M Computer Engineering graduate who enjoys turning complicated problems into practical, user-focused solutions.

I’ve worked across the full development stack, from front-end interfaces and APIs to databases, cloud infrastructure, and automation. My experience spans C#/.NET, JavaScript, SQL, Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, and more, with a particular focus on building maintainable applications and improving existing systems through thoughtful modernization.

I’m naturally curious and enjoy learning new technologies, digging into how systems work, and taking ownership of problems from the initial idea through implementation. Whether I’m developing a new feature, modernizing a legacy application, automating a repetitive process, or improving an existing user experience, I care about creating solutions that are reliable, accessible, and genuinely useful.
When I’m not coding, you’ll usually find me playing flute, crocheting or knitting, painting miniatures, reading, or working on one of the many projects that inevitably finds its way onto my desk.
